summary: Emotional needs merge drive and anger. This concentrated pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and courage with awareness.
body: Emotional needs merge drive and anger. This concentrated pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and courage with awareness. Emotion meets drive and aggression. Feelings are energized and the instinct is to act on them. These drives sit close together, so the pattern may feel natural, immediate, and hard to separate. In practice, this can show up through emotional needs, drive and anger, and the choices you make when mood-driven reaction or reactivity starts running the room.
gift: The gift is emotional intelligence, courage, and a more conscious way to work with emotional needs and drive and anger.
shadow: The shadow is mood-driven reaction, reactivity, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let emotional needs and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
do: Name how emotional needs and drive and anger are both involved
Turn emotional intelligence and courage into one concrete choice
dont: Let mood-driven reaction make the decision
Assume what feels natural is automatically balanced
Ignore the needs of emotional needs or drive and anger
